create_trajectory_generator: create a LaikagoAlternatingLegsTrajectoryGenerator with trot or pace gait for quadruped robot leg motion
compute_motor_angles: compute desired motor angles for all 12 Laikago motors using get_action with current time and input action
generate_alternating_legs_trajectory: generate Gaussian-based alternating leg trajectory signals for stance and retraction phases of each leg
configure_gait_parameters: configure the trajectory generator amplitude frequency and gait type via gin configurable initialization parameters
get_observation_passthrough: get the trajectory generator observation by passing through the input observation unchanged
